value.selection_rule: The one admission rule (R-01), as for 1776, 1805, 1806, 1807, 1808 and 1809: every single printed item in 9 or more newspapers is admitted, except digests; items in 7 or 8 papers are chosen to cover the months and the kinds of news; items are counted one by one; a sub-story may have fewer papers when its parent reaches 7. In 1800, 6 to 10 papers are in print in any three weeks (7 for most of the year), so from February to July an item in 7 papers was printed by every paper that survives for its weeks; no item first printed in May or June reaches 7.
